sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your prompt response and value our long-standing partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our offer stands at a price of €52.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We are prepared to offer a revised price of €52.00, and if you can commit to higher volumes, we would be open to reviewing this further. Which volume can you commit to?

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our costs move with SCRAP-E3, WAGES-METAL, GAS-TTF; the figures stay with us.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
